title: Default extract pipeline selects metadata-text titles as extracted_text for HTML/PDF
description:
## Expected
references process-extract-text-now registers body text usable for vector/lexical indexing, not title-only stubs.

## Observed
Default stages pass-through-text,pdf-text,metadata-text produced selected snapshot text that was only the title (~40–72 bytes) for all four new TI refs. Pass-through HTML (80–250KB) and pdf-text (76KB) existed under stages/ but lost to metadata-text as the pipeline winner.

## Workaround
Re-ran with --stage pass-through-text --force true (HTML) and --stage pdf-text --force true (PDF). HTML is still raw HTML (noisy). Related: repeated --stage A --stage B collapses to last value only; comma form works.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Fixed on epic/e2e-ingestion: default extract stages are pass-through-text,pdf-text (metadata-text omitted). parse_options accumulates repeated --stage flags so both stages actually run.
